Redundancies

By law, under the Employment Rights (NI) Order 1996, employers must notify the Department of plans to make 20+ employees redundant at one site.

To submit a notification of redundancies please click here.

Latest Labour Market Report

The latest Labour Market Report can be accessed via the Labour Market Overview page.

Notification of redundancies

  • Under the Employment Rights (Northern Ireland) Order 1996  (Amended 8 October 2006) you are required by law to notify the Department of a proposal to make redundant 20 or more employees at one establishment.
  • Further information about the redundancy process is available on the   Department for the Economy Website 
  • To submit a notification please click here
